metric_contract.vote_crps: mean absolute error minus one-half mean pairwise absolute difference (V-statistic), in percentage points
metric_contract.joint_energy_score: E||X-y|| minus one-half E||X-X'|| using the V-statistic, party order fixed above
metric_contract.sample_weighting: equal weight per forecast case; per-party means are macro-averages across the eight parties
metric_contract.coverage: central empirical intervals at 50%, 80%, and 90%; width is upper minus lower
metric_contract.seat_draw_policy: seat metrics are unavailable when seat draws or realized seats are missing; no point forecast is converted into draws
